captureBasis: Derived facts were recorded from the pinned local working-tree files, but the source files are intentionally omitted. Repository verification validates this normalized record and does not re-prove extraction.

schematicConnectivity.scope: Physical component identity and board-pad connectivity are normalized exhaustively. Virtual power symbols are counted but not individually normalized, and schematic wire geometry/connectivity was not converted to stable endpoint membership in this capture.
